name: Numemon
main_effect: [On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Monzaemon] in its name and 1 card with [Numemon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon has [Monzaemon] or [Numemon] in its name, it gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
